name: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman
contribution: From the immediate post-partition years onward, he emerged as a student and political organizer in East Bengal, supporting language rights, provincial autonomy, and later the mass movement that led to Bangladesh's independence.
context: East Bengal and East Pakistan, 1948-1971; from early language politics to the autonomy and independence struggle.
impact: His political trajectory connected the post-1947 crisis of representation and language to the later demand for self-determination and statehood.
highlight: His public life linked the first wounds of partition to the final struggle for independence.
